quotes.title: K2-3
quotes.card: K2-3, also known as EPIC 201367065, is a red dwarf star with three known planets.
quotes.introduction: It is on the borderline of being a late orange dwarf/K-type star, but because of its temperature, it is classified as a red dwarf.
